notes.title: The Equinox Club (FREE) Update
notes.content:
Hi!

The latest update to the game introduces many new elements that you asked us for, and develops previous stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/12cd05e926778cddc27327acfb4374800c98bcbf.png[/img]


We are happy to give you the Equinox Club, where Vydija's new neighbor Erika works.
However, unlocking access to the club will not be so easy. Will you be able to successfully get through Vydija and Erika's complicated relationship and make her trust you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/a5ffdd076ffa167f346e81beb94f89199c2eedd4.gif[/img]


Reaching the Equinox Club will allow you to explore a new location, unlock new scenes and dialogues, and meet new people!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/b3b95f8642406b9a36a68204fb8c73f790325cae.gif[/img]

Of course, these are not all the attractions! Check out new partners on the dating site, new gadgets and sex scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/55b42311a26c1e8de8df58cfc7ce2f86c2a0ef07.jpg[/img]

[b]
Full changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]New scenes with neighbor Erika (glory hole)
[*]Possibility to date Erika, not only through the dating site
[*]Three new lesbian sex scenes
[*]Additional sex scene with a gadget
[*]New dresses to buy
[*]New dialogues in the Equinox club
[*]Three new partners to unlock (including Erika)
[*]New interactions and scenes in the Equinox club
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/ec51ed27c49b5820c51ae8fb4a2c71d1fe09653f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/83b074aef391f0a807ee10cfed48fd94162db736.gif[/img]


Have a great weekend! 

/ Madmind

notes.title: The patch 1.1 is ready!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your understanding and patience as you await patches for our Nympho.

Thank you also for all the bugs you reported - on Steam, on Discord, and in e-mails. It took us longer to work on the fixes than we thought, but we can finally share the hotfix with you.

- improved game stability (crashes)
- fixing several bugs related to paying rent
- adding a timer showing how long the janitor waits at the door
- choker placement fix
- lockit update
- lighting optimization
- few bugs in anomaly minigame fixed
- Customer 9 first lin chat bugfix
- bug with missing cigarrete fixed
- many other minor fixes


We would also like to remind you that we intend to continue working on game fixes, optimization and bug fixes that you report.

We invite you to download the update and we apologize for the problems you had to deal with recently.


Best regards,

/ Madmind

notes.title: Nymphomaniac: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hell(o)(o)!

We are pleased to present the new trailer for Nymphomaniac - Sex Addict. The material reveals the new, final release date of the game in the Early Access format! 

[h1]August 27, 2024[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/b32894316f543eb907bbb0b826addff5d7946cf4.jpg[/img]

You can see the trailer now, uncensored, on the steam page! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002570/Nymphomaniac__Sex_Addict/

Why do we need more time? 
We try to learn from our mistakes and want to give you a well-functioning and optimized game on launch day. That's why we decided to give ourselves more time for polish and bugfixing. 

It's only a month, you can bear it ;)

How to make waiting for Nymphomaniac less painfull? We encourage you to try the new game mode for Succubus - Roguelike! 
Starring, of course, your favorite heroine - Vydija. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057500/Succubus__Elysian_Fields/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/5ed73635fd7d9efd2dd7635744120d82c9c302f8.jpg[/img]

Oh, and drop by our discord. Most often, this is where all the news appears. There is also a "feedback" section where you can present your ideas and feedback.

https://discord.gg/zCtmn7uJ


Join in :)


/ Madmind
